sentences.text:
Author: Samit Gopal
Bench: Samit Gopal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:112093 Court
No. - 71 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 18936 of 2023 Applicant :- Rinkoo Verma Opposite
Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Maurya Counsel for
Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J. 1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri Manoj Kumar Maurya
learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ankit Srivastava, learned counsel for the State and perused the
record. 3.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Rinkoo Verma
with the prayer to quash the cognizance order dated 10.11.2022, charge sheet dated 9.11.2021 as well
as entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 13539 of 2022 (State Vs. Rinkoo Verma) in case crime no.
0211 of 2021, u/s 419, 420 Ipc and Section 67 of Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008,
P.S. Kothibhar, District Maharajganj pending before Civil Judge (J.D.), Judicial Magistrate,
Maharajganj and further to stay the further proceedings of the aforesaid case during the pendency of
this application before this Hon'ble Court.

4. After some arguments, learned counsel for the
applicant has made a statement at the Bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press other
prayers made in the instant application and states that the applicant is ready to surrender before the
court below and seek his bail and that his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble
Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another :
(2021) 10 Scc 773.

entities.text:
Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another :
(2021) 10 Scc 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5 . Per contra, learned counsel for the State states that he has no objection to the
aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants for not pressing the other prayers made
in the instant application.

6. In view of the above, in case the applicant appears/ surrenders before
the court below within 30 days from today and seeks bail, his release be considered in view of law
laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (Supra).

7. Till the aforesaid
period, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant(s) in the aforesaid case.

8. It is
clarified that if the accused-applicant does not appear before the court concerned by the said date,
the court concerned shall proceed against him in accordance with law.
9.  With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed off.
Gaurav  Rinkoo Verma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023
